t: A brand new 280 MHz STM32 chip family for motors and power control.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-G564RE from the ST eStore for about 48 US dollars.
Install Zephyr and its setup tools on your computer.
Install the free STM32CubeProgrammer app for flashing.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Build the Blinky sample for the nucleo_g564re board.
Flash it and watch the light flash.
Explore ST's STM32CubeMX2 tool and HAL2 drivers for motor work next.
